rubric_items.deep_module: pass — four pure functions (`topology.read`, `current.book`, `gs.apply`, `solve.fixed_point`) each hide substantial behaviour (topology read + membership clip + derivative of the support map + a Newton-GMRES scan behind three signatures); this is a stage decomposition of the 4133-line `ForwardFluxOperator` and `fixed_point.py`, not a spread of wrappers over one body.

rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied counts public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds a public name states the owner it retires or merges into (§2/§5 fold `TopologyPolicy`/`SolvePolicy` into `ForwardSolvePolicy`; §2–§5 name the functions they replace), and §6's request-surface ruling collapses `SolveRoute` six-to-one, deletes `SupportClipMode` and removes eight plumbing fields with a stated before/after field count.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan runs the reuse map and cites a real mechanism for every helper: the contour tree (verified called by the landed read, topology.py:2910), the single-site GMRES kernel, the backtracking helpers, the operand-layout machinery, the clip helpers, polygon_moments.py and the moment-map derivative; it also withdraws candidates with reasons (field-null kernels, `_steepest_descent_promotion`).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — each new module states what it replaces rather than wraps: §2 replaces `Topology.read`/`read_with_connectivity`; §3 replaces `clipped_support_current_moments` and the support partition; §4 replaces the map `ForwardFluxOperator` performs "rather than wrapping it"; §5 replaces `newton_krylov`/`picard`/`operator_request_body`.
